about: Cells that only the running game can confirm. status: pending | passed | failed | skipped-by-design. A release is not called tested until every row has passed.

rows.question: Does every pattern match on the player's current RDR2 build? (ArthurGatling.log lists each)
Does the log show 'script thread running' after the loading screen?
Does gatling_gun spawn and attach, with the wheels gone?
Does the Gatling sit at Arthur's hip with the barrel forward? (tune attachOffset/attachRot)
Does mech_carry_box/idle hold the arms in place while walking (upper body only)?
Do bullets and the flash leave the barrel tip?
Is WEAPON_TURRET_GATLING valid (log), and do bullets hurt people with Gatling sound?
Holding Shift with the Gatling out: no sprint, but walking/jogging normal?
Never tested by going online with the mod (that risks the account). Checked instead by reading the code path and the log line 'online session -> mod idle'.
